question: In which year was the first railway line constructed in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1853**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Railway in India:-**

 
 
• **The first railway line in India was constructed in the year 1853, between Bombay (now Mumbai) and Thane.**
 
• The line was constructed by the Great Indian Peninsula Railway (GIPR) under the British East India Company's rule.
 
• The 34 km long railway line was opened for public use on 16th April 1853, and it was a major milestone in the history of Indian transportation.
 
• The first train that ran on this line was named 'The Sahib', and it had three steam locomotives named 'Sindh', 'Sultan', and 'Sahib'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 1887 was the year when the first electric tramway was introduced in India, in the city of Bombay.
 
• 1890 represents the year when the first railway line was constructed in the state of Madras (now Chennai) by the Madras Railway Company, connecting the port city of Madras with the inland town of Arcot.
